description: Programmation travaux voirie 2024 is a dataset listed in cc-lacqorthez-data64 open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by CCLO. Linéaires localisant les travaux programmés de voirie sur la CCLO en 2024. Coverage: Lacq-Orthez (Pyrénées-Atlantiques). The portal files it under Travaux. Its keywords are travaux, voirie. The portal shows 120 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2024-03-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-cc-lacqorthez-fr-portal.
